reason: I've paid for a reporting tool before that ate weeks of setup and then nobody opened it. Pulling CSVs out of the PSA and billing system and digging out contract PDFs is an afternoon I don't have, especially with month-end invoicing already running long.
objection: No integration means I'm doing the donkey work of exporting and uploading, and £4,281 on made-up demo data tells me nothing about whether it'll find anything real in my book or just give me another dashboard full of 'potential' I have to chase down myself.
would_change_my_mind: A direct PSA and billing integration, or them doing the exports and first audit for me, so I see real money found on my own clients without giving up an afternoon.
